dedupe_keys.name: ippodamo digital twin decision support for urban facility maintenance bologna bi rex

description: IPPODAMO (Interactive Planning Platform for City District Adaptive Maintenance Operations) is a distributed geographical system built as a digital twin to support urban facility management. It ingests heterogeneous data from different urban data providers, refines them continuously and builds synthetic indexes of activity within an area of interest, taking into account interference from other stakeholders, so that operators maintaining urban assets can see what else is happening where they plan work. The paper notes that each maintainer has only a local view, periodically consolidated in a joint conference called by the municipality, and presents a detailed proof-of-concept implementation extending earlier work. Coverage: the project's pilot area. Access: open-access article in Sensors (2021); no data are shared. Licence: CC-BY-4.0 article. Caveats: a proof of concept; the city and datasets are not named in detail in the text read. Simulation uses: coordinating roadworks and public space maintenance to limit disruption. Related records: the DTCC digital twin cities platform and the Athens metro station security digital twin.
